claim_formal: ∀ complex CM abelian variety A, ∀ p ≥ 0, ∀ α ∈ H^{2p}(A,ℚ)∩H^{p,p}(A): ∃ Z ∈ CH^p(A)_ℚ with cl_B(Z) = α

quote_A.text: every rational Hodge class on such a variety is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycle classes

quote_B.text: We prove the rational Hodge conjecture for complex abelian varieties with complex multiplication

notes: Surjectivity of the cycle-class map read as ∀α∃Z (M2); M1 'property holds' is the alternative. Hodge conjecture restricted to CM abelian varieties → O5. Corollaries via Milne: Tate conjecture for abelian varieties over finite fields, Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in all characteristics; generalized Hodge for CM. Other manuscripts: HC/GHC on a K3 quadratic locus via algebraic Kuga–Satake, Weil classes on powers of abelian sixfolds, a conditional Kuga–Satake reduction.

claim_formal: ∀ compact Fujiki-class-C manifold X, ∀ rational SNC boundary Δ, ∀ connected-fibre surjection f:X→Y onto a normal compact complex space: κ(X,K_X+Δ) ≥ κ(F,K_F+Δ_F) + κ(f|Δ)

quote_A.text: \kappa(X,K_X+\Delta) \geq\kappa(F,K_F+\Delta_F)+\kappa(f\mid\Delta)

quote_B.text: We prove Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity conjecture for rational simple normal crossing boundaries on compact manifolds in Fujiki class

notes: Headline = Campana's orbifold Iitaka subadditivity (implies ordinary and log subadditivity). Lean comparator LogKodairaFiberNegative (truncated) formalizes a piece of the companion reverse log-Kodaira inequality, not the headline → different. Family also proves ordinary Iitaka C_{n,m} in char 0, Popa's log variation conjecture (κ̄(V)≥0), Popa's log additivity in the stratum-smooth reduced-SNC setting, Kähler log-smooth b-semiampleness. Tsuji/Maehara preprints stated ordinary subadditivity but are not counted as proofs, so not O9. O1 vs O5: SNC rational boundary on Fujiki-C manifolds is presumably the conjecture's natural scope.

claim_formal: Assuming log Iitaka subadditivity: ∀ normal irreducible compact Kähler space X, ∀ effective ℚ-divisor Δ with (X,Δ) lc and K_X+Δ ℚ-Cartier: K_X+Δ analytically nef → K_X+Δ semiample

conditional_on: logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for smooth projective reduced-SNC pairs

quote_A.text: analytic nefness of $`K_X+\Delta`$ implies semiampleness

quote_B.text: Assume logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity for surjective morphisms with connected fibers between smooth projective complex varieties with compatible reduced simple normal crossing boundaries. We prove log abundance for normal irreducible compact Kähler spaces in every dimension

notes: Headline as titled is conditional (O6), but the hypothesis is proved in family 033 (cited as OpenAIIitaka2026 Cor. 6.2), so combined it is effectively an unconditional settlement of Kähler log abundance (O1 + builds_on_model_output). Sibling manuscripts: projective log abundance in every dimension over alg. closed char-0 fields (cites subadditivity as a theorem), canonical nonvanishing, effective Iitaka fibration conjecture (Birkar–Zhang), uniform slc log CY index, Birkar Stein-degree conjecture, fourfold Kähler results.

claim_formal: ∀ alg. closed k with char p > 3, ∀ projective lc threefold pair (X,B) over k with B effective ℚ-divisor and K_X+B ℚ-Cartier: (K_X+B nef ∧ ν(K_X+B)=1) → K_X+B semiample

quote_A.text: If $`(X,B)`$ is a projective log canonical threefold pair with effective rational boundary, and $`K_X+B`$ is ℚ-Cartier, nef, and of numerical dimension one, then $`K_X+B`$ is semiample.

quote_B.text: The theorem proves the numerical-dimension-one case of threefold log abundance in this characteristic range.

notes: Abundance conjecture restricted to threefolds, char p>3, ν=1. With Xu's nef-dimension ≤2 and ν=2 results this closes the remaining ν=1, nef-dimension-3 case; companion terminal-threefold manuscript supplies a cycle obstruction used as input.

claim_formal: ∀ projective klt ℚ-pair (X,B) over an alg. closed char-0 field, ∀ nef ℚ-Cartier M: (K_X+B pseudo-effective ∧ K_X+B+M nef) → ∃ semiample ℚ-Cartier L with K_X+B+M ≡ L

quote_A.text: then there is a semiample $\Q$-Cartier divisor $L$ on $X$ such that $D\equiv L$.

quote_B.text: We prove the Generalised Abundance Conjecture

notes: 'Numerically semiample' read as ∃L (M2); M1 is the alternative. Lazić–Peternell Generalised Abundance Conjecture. Proof uses the companion log-abundance theorem (OpenAI, family 034) and terminating MMP → builds_on_model_output. Also: compact Kähler klt SNC version in Bott–Chern cohomology, existence of minimal models / Mori fibre spaces for generalized lc ℚ-pairs, minimal models when κ_σ=1.

claim_formal: ∀ n ≥ 2, ∀ singular klt germ (X,x) of dimension n with zero boundary: nvol(x,X) ≤ 2(n−1)^n, and equality ⇔ (X,x)_an ≅ ordinary double point

quote_A.text: a singular n-dimensional germ has normalized volume at most $`2(n-1)^n`$, with equality precisely at an analytic ordinary double point

quote_B.text: We prove the ordinary-double-point gap conjecture for boundary-zero complex algebraic klt germs in every dimension

notes: Spotti–Sun ODP volume-gap conjecture (also Problem 33 in a K-stability problem list, so P3 arguable). Induction uses the fourfold case proved in the same family. Corollary: volume bounds for singular K-semistable ℚ-Fano varieties.

claim_formal: ∀ n ≥ 1, ∀ smooth connected complex projective X of dimension n, ∀ ample line bundle L: K_X+(n+1)L is globally generated

quote_A.text: then $`K_X+mL`$ is globally generated for every integer $`m\geq n+1`$

quote_B.text: We prove Fujita's freeness conjecture.

notes: Global-generation property with explicit threshold n+1 (sharp via P^n), so M9 is arguable. Only the freeness part; very-ampleness part of Fujita not claimed. Earlier announced proof (Chan) was withdrawn, so not O9.

claim_formal: ∀ r ≥ 10, for very general (p_1,…,p_r) ∈ (P^2_ℂ)^r, ∀ nonzero effective plane curve C of degree d, ∀ m_i ≤ mult_{p_i}C: Σ m_i < d√r

quote_A.text: We prove that a nonzero effective plane curve of degree d at r ≥ 10 very general complex points has total multiplicity strictly less than $`d\sqrt r`$.

quote_B.text: establishes Nagata's conjecture in its strict, nonhomogeneous form

notes: Strict one-sided bound (M8); equivalently the multipoint Seshadri constant equals 1/√r (M9 reading). Prefix could be compressed to ∀ᵍ. Lean comparator 'Nagata' is truncated; assumed to state the headline. Also: Nagata–Biran for surfaces and Nagata–Biran–Szemberg in dim ≥3 for r ≫ 0 (∀^∞, ineffective r_0) over ℂ and in char p at geometric generic tuples; Lean MaximalSeshadriConstants for that.

claim_formal: ∀ smooth connected projective complex surface S with p_g(S)=0: alb_S: CH_0(S)^0 → Alb(S)(ℂ) is an isomorphism (integral coefficients)

quote_A.text: the Albanese homomorphism on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism

quote_B.text: Bloch's conjecture predicts that it is an isomorphism when \(p_g(S)=0\). We prove the conjecture.

notes: New input is p_g=q=0 (deg: CH_0(S) ≅ ℤ); non-general-type cases come from Bloch–Kas–Lieberman → full_only_with_prior_results. M7 (isomorphism of named groups) vs M1. Corollaries: Kimura finite-dimensionality, pure Tate motives of powers/Hilbert schemes. Overlapping preprints (Guletskii) noted in paper.

claim_formal: ∀ compact IHS Kähler manifold X, ∀ holomorphic line bundle L with c_1(L) ≠ 0 nef and q_X(c_1(L)) = 0: L is semiample

quote_A.text: every holomorphic line bundle with nonzero nef isotropic first Chern class on a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold is semiample

quote_B.text: We prove the strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture

notes: Verbitsky's strong SYZ conjecture. Second result: projective-space base conjecture (normal projective base of a projective Lagrangian fibration is P^n, M7/M6). Corollary: finitely many deformation types of IHS manifolds of fixed dimension with b_2 ≥ 5 (with EFGMS boundedness).

claim_formal: ∀ complex K3 surface X: X is Oka, i.e. ∀ m, ∀ compact convex K ⊂ ℂ^m, ∀ f holomorphic near K, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ entire F: ℂ^m → X with sup_K d(F,f) < ε

quote_A.text: We prove that every complex K3 surface X is Oka, resolving the K3 Oka conjecture.

quote_B.text: proves the positive conjecture formulated explicitly in

notes: Prefix read at the level of 'X is Oka'; unpacking CAP gives ∀∃. Also answers Forstnerič–Lárusson survey Problem C (P3 arguable). Family also: all minimal compact surfaces of Kodaira dim 0 are Oka; minimal class VII surface is Oka iff Hopf or Enoki (uses the GSS theorem of family 060); dense entire immersions on K3s.

claim_formal: ∀ smooth projective complex curve C of genus ≥ 2, ∀ composite n ≥ 4, ∀ d with gcd(n,d)=1, ∀ L ∈ Pic^d(C), ∀ m,k: P_k H^m(X^B,ℚ) = W_{2k} H^m(X^B,ℚ) = W_{2k+1} H^m(X^B,ℚ)

quote_A.text: We prove the P = W conjecture on the full rational cohomology of fixed-determinant, trace-free Higgs moduli spaces in composite rank and coprime degree

quote_B.text: Together with the established prime-rank cases, this gives the equality in every coprime rank.

notes: Theorem covers composite ranks only; prime ranks from [MS2024] complete the fixed-determinant P=W conjecture in all coprime ranks → O1 + full_only_with_prior_results; O5 if the headline is read as composite rank only. Includes variant cohomology.

claim_formal: ∀ finite quiver Q, ∀ dimension and framing vectors, ∀ commuting flavor torus F, ∀ regular stability character ν: H_F^*(X;ℂ) ≅ ℂ[Y_f^ν] as graded R-algebras (both coefficient maps surjective with equal kernels)

quote_A.text: They therefore induce a canonical isomorphism of graded $R$-algebras

quote_B.text: We prove the equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary finite quivers, including loops and multiple arrows.

notes: Under the regularity hypothesis (semistable = stable, free gauge action), which is part of the conjecture's smooth setting. Earlier cases for special quiver types are not visible in the excerpt; if the headline is seen as extending them, O8.

claim_formal: ∃ smooth connected projective complex fourfold X (with simple abelian surface A ⊂ X, im(π_1(A)→π_1(X)) ≅ ℤ) such that X has large π_1, X̃ contains no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety, and X̃ is not Stein

quote_A.text: The universal cover $\widetilde X$ contains no positive-dimensional compact complex analytic subvariety and is not Stein.

quote_B.text: this disproves Shafarevich's holomorphic-convexity conjecture even under the large-fundamental-group hypothesis

notes: Second manuscript: smooth projective surface whose universal cover is not holomorphically convex (infinite Nori string), disproving the conjecture in dimension two. Shafarevich's question could be classed P2.

claim_formal: ∃ integral complex affine fourfold X = Spec A, A = ℂ[p,s,u,F,J]/(H) explicit: A[w] ≅ ℂ^[5] ∧ A ≇ ℂ^[4]

quote_A.text: We construct an explicit integral complex affine fourfold X with $`X\times\mathbb A^1\cong\mathbb A^5`$ but $`X\not\cong\mathbb A^4`$.

quote_B.text: This gives a negative answer to Zariski's affine-space cancellation problem over ℂ in dimension four.

notes: Lean MainStatement matches (finite type, domain, Krull dim 4, A[X] ≅ ℂ[5 vars], A ≇ ℂ[4 vars]). Negative answer in dimension 4 only (dimension 3 over ℂ still open); O2 because a counterexample answers the general cancellation question, O5 arguable. Corollaries: Stable Coordinate Conjecture fails in ambient dim 5; Dolgachev–Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture fails over A^1 and A^2. Cancellation problem treated as open question (P2); P1 arguable.

claim_formal: ∃ finitely generated normal integral ℂ-algebra A of Krull dimension 2 and maximal ideal m: Der_ℂ(A) ≅ A^{⊕2} ∧ A_m not regular

quote_A.text: We construct a singular normal affine complex surface whose tangent sheaf is free of rank two.

quote_B.text: This disproves the Lipman–Zariski conjecture in characteristic zero.

notes: Analytic isolated Gorenstein singularity (exceptional curve of genus 21, self-intersection −10) algebraized.

claim_formal: ∃ explicit degree-5 f ∈ ℂ[x_1,…,x_4]: f is a coordinate of ℂ[x_1,…,x_4,w] but not of ℂ[x_1,…,x_4]

quote_A.text: There is a $\C$-algebra automorphism of $R[w]$ sending $f$ to $x_1$, but there is no such automorphism of $R$.

quote_B.text: This gives a counterexample to the stable coordinate conjecture in four variables.

notes: Four variables is the first possible dimension (conjecture holds for n ≤ 3). Lean StableCoordinateFour matches (plus fibre package). Corollary: every fibre is A^3 and non-rectifiable → Abhyankar–Sathaye counterexample in ambient dim 4; second manuscript gives another Abhyankar–Sathaye counterexample for all n ≥ 4 (Lean AbhyankarSathaye, CommutingDerivations).

claim_formal: ∃ explicit rank-2 algebraic bundle G on P^1×P^1: ∀ m ≥ 1, E_m = f_m^*G ⊗ O(1,1) is ample, and ∃ m_0 ∀ m ≥ m_0, E_m has no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric

quote_A.text: There is an integer $m_0$ such that $E_m$ admits no smooth Hermitian metric with strictly Griffiths-positive Chern curvature for every $m\ge m_0$.

quote_B.text: We give counterexamples to Griffiths' conjecture in rank two on the quadric surface

notes: m_0 obtained by compactness and stated to be ineffective. Lean QuadricBundles SourceMainTheorem is truncated; assumed to match.

claim_formal: ∀ compact connected Kähler manifold X of positive dimension: (every holomorphic map ℂ → X is constant) → K_X ample

quote_A.text: every compact connected Kähler manifold of positive complex dimension containing no nonconstant entire curve has ample canonical bundle and is projective

quote_B.text: This resolves positively Kobayashi's canonical-ampleness conjecture in the smooth compact Kähler category.

notes: 'Smooth compact Kähler category' is the conjecture's usual scope, so O1 (O5 if a singular version is counted). Corollary: such X is projective.

claim_formal: ∀ compact connected Kähler X of dim ≥ 2, ∀ splitting T_X = E_1 ⊕ E_2 into integrable holomorphic subbundles of positive rank: ∃ simply connected Y_1, Y_2 and biholomorphism Φ: X̃ → Y_1×Y_2 with dΦ(π^*E_i) = pr_i^*T_{Y_i}

quote_A.text: then its ordinary universal cover admits a product decomposition whose factor tangent bundles are the lifted specified summands

quote_B.text: We prove the two-summand form of Beauville's compatible splitting conjecture.

notes: Beauville's conjecture restricted to two summands → O5; O1 if the two-summand form (Höring Conj. 1.4) is taken as its own problem. Lean KahlerSplitting matches. Second manuscript proves Höring's conjecture on rationally connected manifolds (both summands integrable, giving a product; Lean SplitTangentIntegrability). Corollaries for non-uniruled and K_X nef-big projective manifolds.

claim_formal: ∃ (g,n) = (10^60, 3·C(10^60,3)) and explicit Y ∈ S_{g,n}: q_{g,n}(Y) = 0 in CH^*(M̄_{g,n};ℚ) ∧ Y ∉ Pspan_{g,n}

quote_A.text: Consequently Pixton's original relation span does not exhaust the tautological Chow relations

quote_B.text: We disprove the Chow and rational-cohomological forms of Pixton's completeness conjecture for his original relation system.

notes: Refutes completeness of Pixton's original span in Chow and in rational cohomology; refined or extended relation systems are not addressed.

claim_formal: ∃ d_0 ∀ admissible d > d_0, for very general cubic fourfold X ∈ C_d: X is irrational ∧ Ku(X) ≃ D^b(Coh S) for a smooth projective K3 surface S

quote_A.text: For every sufficiently large admissible Hassett discriminant, we prove that a very general cubic fourfold of that discriminant is irrational

quote_B.text: This disproves Kuznetsov's rationality conjecture.

notes: Irrationality (non-existence of birational map) under ∀^∞∀ᵍ → M4; but the cubics serve as counterexamples to Kuznetsov's conjecture, so M3 is the main alternative. BUCKETS_PLAN calls 054 '∀ᵍ with a negated matrix'; ∀^∞ added per tie-break rule 2 (ineffective d_0). Corollaries: associated-K3 sufficiency fails, Hilbert-square sufficiency fails, universally trivial CH_0 for these irrational cubics.

claim_formal: ∀ smooth complex quintic threefold X: ∃ numerical Bridgeland stability condition σ = (Z,P) with support property, Z(ΦE) = e^{2πi/5}Z(E), Φ(P(φ)) = P(φ+2/5), Z(O_x) = −1

quote_A.text: Every smooth complex quintic threefold admits a numerical Bridgeland stability condition

quote_B.text: We prove Toda's normalized quintic Gepner conjecture.

notes: Second manuscript: geometric stability conditions with exact large-volume (ordinary and √Todd) charges on every CY threefold at sufficiently large volume, plus a uniform strong tilt inequality on all smooth projective threefolds.

claim_formal: ∀ normal globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfold X_0, ∀ rational boundary B_0, ∀ fixed analytically nef rational b-divisor M with (X_0,B_0+M) generalized lc, ∀ sequence of projective small generalized lc flips: the sequence is finite

quote_A.text: Every sequence of generalized log canonical flips on a normal irreducible globally Weil ℚ-factorial compact Kähler fourfold terminates

quote_B.text: We prove that every permitted minimal model program for a projective log canonical fourfold with rational boundary over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero terminates.

notes: Termination of flips conjecture in dimension 4 only → O5. 'Terminates' read as property (M1); M4 (no infinite flip sequence) is the alternative. Existence of flips not asserted. Family also: termination of arbitrary permitted MMP for projective lc fourfolds (char 0), generalized-canonical Kähler version, finite ordinary MMP for Kähler klt fourfolds.

claim_formal: ∀ connected smooth compact Kähler manifold X: X special → π_1(X) has an abelian subgroup of finite index

quote_A.text: If \(X\) is special, then \(\pi_1(X)\) has an abelian subgroup of finite index.

quote_B.text: resolving Campana's abelianity conjecture in all dimensions

notes: Corollaries: κ=0 compact Kähler manifolds have virtually abelian π_1; Campana's Conjecture S; holomorphic convexity of universal covers of special manifolds. Other manuscripts: two-step nilpotent linear monodromy for special quasi-projective varieties (previously announced by Cao–Deng–Hacon–Păun, so O9 for that piece); conditional result for order-two root orbifolds of fourfolds.

claim_formal: ∀ connected normal projective complex variety X: (X̃ biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety) ⇔ (∃ m, bounded symmetric D, simply connected normal projective F: X̃ ≅ D × ℂ^m × F)

quote_A.text: the universal cover of a connected normal projective complex variety is biholomorphic to a semialgebraic open subset of a projective variety if and only if it is a product of a bounded symmetric domain, a complex affine space, and a simply connected normal projective variety

quote_B.text: We prove the Kollár–Pardon conjecture

notes: Characterization (M5); M6 classification arguable. Uses the OpenAI abelianity theorem for special Kähler manifolds (family 057) → builds_on_model_output. Lean SymmetricDomains formalizes the companion bounded-domain theorem (semialgebraic bounded domain with compact quotient is bounded symmetric), a secondary result → different. Corollaries: quasi-projective cover iff no bounded factor; ℂ^n-covered smooth projective varieties are finitely covered by abelian varieties.

claim_formal: ∃ N (8 | N) ∃ reduced weighted-homogeneous f_1, f_2 ∈ ℝ[z_1,…,z_N] with isolated critical points, ord_0 f_1 = 2, ord_0 f_2 = 3, and (ℂ^N,V(f_1),0) ≅ (ℂ^N,V(f_2),0) ambiently homeomorphic

quote_A.text: We construct two reduced hypersurface germs that are ambiently homeomorphic but have multiplicities two and three.

quote_B.text: We give a negative answer to the embedded Zariski multiplicity conjecture.

notes: Second manuscript: counterexample in ℂ^4 with multiplicities 4 and 5. Same examples answer Arnold's corank problem negatively. Zariski's question (1971) could be classed P2.

claim_formal: ∀ connected minimal compact complex surface X of class VII with b_2(X) > 0: ∃ global spherical shell Σ ⊂ X (biholomorphic image of a neighbourhood of S^3 ⊂ ℂ^2∖{0} with X∖Σ connected)

quote_A.text: every connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII with positive second Betti number contains a global spherical shell

quote_B.text: We prove the Global Spherical Shell conjecture

notes: Nakamura's Working Hypothesis 5.5 (b_2 = 1 was Teleman). Corollaries: deformation to blown-up primary Hopf surfaces, π_1 ≅ ℤ and diffeomorphism type; sharpened Euler–signature inequality for aspherical complex surfaces.

claim_formal: ∀ closed connected positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold (M^{4m},g), m ≥ 2: (M,g) is homothetic to a Wolf space (via: ∀ contact Fano X of dim ≥ 3 ∃ simple 𝔤 with (X,F) ≅ adjoint variety Y_𝔤)

quote_A.text: Every smooth connected complex projective contact Fano manifold of complex dimension at least three, with its given contact distribution, is contact-isomorphic to the adjoint variety of a simple complex Lie algebra.

quote_B.text: We resolve the contact-Fano homogeneity conjecture and the Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon conjecture positively.

notes: Two named conjectures settled together (contact-Fano homogeneity is the main theorem; LeBrun–Salamon a corollary via twistor spaces). Classification against the Wolf-space / adjoint-variety list → M6 (M7 arguable). Also: classification of all projective contact manifolds by b_2, Kähler–Einstein existence on contact Fano manifolds.

claim_formal: ∀ smooth connected complex Fano manifold X of dimension n > 0, Picard number ρ, pseudoindex ι: ρ(ι−1) ≤ n, and equality ⇔ X ≅ (P^{ι−1})^ρ

quote_A.text: satisfies $`\rho(\iota-1)\le n`$. Equality holds precisely for the product of ρ copies of $`\mathbb P^{\iota-1}`$.

quote_B.text: We prove the generalized Mukai conjecture

notes: Sharp bound with attainment and equality classification → M9 (M6 for the equality part). Bonavero–Casagrande–Debarre–Druel pseudoindex form.

claim_formal: ∀ holomorphic one-parameter family F: (ℂ^3×Δ, 0×Δ) → (ℂ,0) of isolated singularities with μ(f_t,0) constant: ∃ jointly continuous homeomorphism germ Φ(x,t) = (φ_t(x),t), φ_t(0)=0, φ_0 = id, f_t∘φ_t = f_0

quote_A.text: We prove that every holomorphic one-parameter family of isolated hypersurface singularities in ℂ3 with constant Milnor number is topologically right-trivial.

quote_B.text: This gives a positive answer to the surface case of the μ-constant problem.

notes: Surface case (ℂ^3) of the Lê–Ramanujam μ-constant problem; all other dimensions were done by Lê–Ramanujam/Timourian/King, so with prior results the whole problem is settled (O1 + full_only_with_prior_results arguable; the surface case is the only open case and is often posed on its own). 'Problem' wording suggests P2 is also possible.
